title: Axe helper and per-route pattern for the Angular template
goal: A helper that fails a browser test on serious or critical axe violations of a route
acceptance: `angular/` ships `axe` helper code and a documented pattern: one pass per route listed by the project, failing on serious and critical violations, reporting moderate ones
A fixture page with a missing form label proves the helper fails; a clean page passes
The documentation names the route list and where the project keeps it
Failing test committed first: the seeded-violation fixture expects failure against an empty helper; the change never edits that test to pass
privacy: Neutral content only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git. Fixtures are invented.
validation: npm run check:fast; final applicable CI
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: The report's 3 h split in two: the helper and fixtures here. Estimated 2026-11-26 at agent speed from the report's effort column. Not a measurement.
